s.note: Pan-toasted leg ham and cheddar sandwiches, cut into triangles
s.how: Butter the outsides of 8 slices of bread and fill 4 sandwiches with 150g ham and 150g grated cheddar. Cook in a pan over medium heat for exactly 3 minutes a side and cut into neat triangles.

s.n: Ana's bakery cheddar and chive scones
s.note: Harold came to audit her. Ana only paid the taxes she agreed with
s.how: Tall cheddar scones with chives, served warm with whipped butter. Rub 60g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour with 1 tsp salt and a pinch of cayenne. Stir in 120g grated vintage cheddar and half a bunch of snipped chives, then 300ml milk to a soft dough. Pat 3cm thick, cut 8 rounds, brush with milk, top with 30g more cheddar and bake at 220C for 15 minutes. Whip 100g soft butter and serve with the warm scones.

m.note: Chicken thigh and leek in creamy sauce under a puff pastry lid
m.how: Cook 800g diced chicken thigh with 2 sliced leeks in 30g butter. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, 300ml chicken stock and 100ml cream and simmer 10 minutes. Spoon into a dish, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Thank God for Bavarian sugar cookies. Brown butter, vanilla.
w.how: Brown 150g butter until nutty and cool 10 minutes. Whisk with 100g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 100g plain flour, 60g spelt flour, 40g rye flour, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt. Chill 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 180C. Roll into 16 balls, roll in demerara sugar and bake 11 to 12 minutes. Sprinkle with flaky salt while warm.

d.note: Cold milk with vanilla bean, malt powder and honey in frosted glasses
d.how: Put 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Scrape the seeds from half a vanilla bean into a jug. Add 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 1 tbsp honey and 100ml milk and whisk into a smooth paste. Add 900ml very cold full cream milk and whisk hard, or blend for 20 seconds, until frothy. Pour into the frosted glasses and dust with a little more malt.
